statements.status_notes: Upstream commits c892114 and 8b3535c make multipathd IPC client sockets non-blocking and avoid blocking send() in CLT_SEND unless POLLOUT is set, preventing the local denial of service described in GHSA-hmcm-9cq4-r2xm. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-89329
